greet.stranger: Well met, traveller. I am {name}, sworn to protect those who cannot protect themselves.
Peace be with you. These roads are dangerous after dark.
Greetings. You look weary. Have you eaten today?
I am {name}. If you have need of a shield, you need only ask.
Hail, friend. May your path be lit and your blade be true.
greet.owner: I am here, {player}. How may I serve?
My friend. What do you require?
At your side, as always. Speak.
You called, and I am here.
recruit.accept: Then I swear it: no harm shall come to you while I stand.
It would be my honour to walk with you, {player}.
I accept. My shield is yours.
So be it. I will guard you as I would my own kin.
recruit.party_full: You already travel with {count} companions. I would only be in the way. Perhaps another time.
Your company is full, friend. I will not crowd your path.
recruit.already: I am already sworn to you, {player}.
My oath already binds me to you.
dismiss.accept: As you wish. My oath stands, should you ever need me again.
Go safely, {player}. I will return home and keep watch there.
Farewell, friend. I will pray for your safe return.
dismiss.not_recruited: I have sworn no oath to you yet, friend. There is nothing to release.
not_recruited: I would gladly help, but I must first know we walk the same road. Ask me to join you.
Forgive me, but I take orders only from those I have sworn to protect.
ack.follow: Lead on. I will guard your back.
Go on, {player}. I am right behind you.
ack.follow.already: I have not left your side, friend.
ack.wait: I will hold this place until you return.
Very well. I will wait, and I will be ready.
This ground is mine to guard. Go.
ack.wait.already: I am already keeping watch here.
ack.gather: I will gather {count} {item} for you. Stay where I can see you.
Honest work is good for the soul. {count} {item}, then.
ack.cancel: As you wish. I have stopped.
ack.cancel.nothing: I am not engaged in any task, friend.
ack.come: Hold fast, I am on my way.
ack.attack: The {mob} will not trouble you further.
ack.give.nothing: I carry nothing to give, I am sorry.
status.idle: I am at rest, but ready.
status.follow: At your side, watching for danger.
status.wait: Keeping watch over this place, as you asked.
Holding this ground until you return.
status.downed: I have fallen, but I will rise.
fail.unknown_item: Forgive me, I do not know what "{item}" is.
"{item}"? I know of no such thing. Could you name it another way?
fail.not_gatherable: {item} is not something I can gather from the land, friend.
I am sorry. {item} must be made or found, not gathered.
fail.needs_tool: I cannot take {item} without a {tool}. If you lend me one, I will do it gladly.
This calls for a {tool}, which I do not have.
fail.none_found: I have searched, but there is no {item} within reach.
There is no {item} near here. We may find some elsewhere.
fail.unreachable: I see {item}, but I cannot reach it safely.
The {item} is beyond my reach. Forgive me.
fail.inventory_full: My pack is full. I gathered {have} {item} before it filled.
I can carry no more. Will you take some of my burden?
fail.count_invalid: I cannot gather that many. No more than {max}, and at least one.
fail.downed: Give me a moment to rise, friend.
fail.refuse_target: No. I will not raise my blade against a {mob}. It has done us no wrong.
I swore to protect, not to harm the innocent. Not the {mob}.
fail.stuck: I cannot find a path. The way is blocked.
Forgive me, I cannot get through.
unclear.generic: Forgive me, I do not understand. What would you have me do?
I did not follow that, friend. Could you say it plainly?
I am uncertain what you ask. Shall I follow, wait, or gather something?
unclear.gather_what: Gladly. But what shall I gather, and how much?
unclear.ambiguous: There are several: {options}. Which do you wish?
progress.gather: I have {have} of {count} {item}. I will continue.
done.gather: I have gathered all {count} {item}. I am returning to you.
done.delivered: {count} {item}, gathered and delivered. What else may I do?
partial.gather: I found only {have} of the {count} {item}. There is no more nearby.
Forgive me. {have} {item} was all I could find.
combat.low_health: I am wounded, but I stand.
combat.retreat: I must fall back. Stay close!
combat.player_low_health: {player}, you are gravely hurt! Get behind me and eat!
You must tend to your wounds, {player}. I will cover you.
downed: I have fallen... but not yet failed.
Forgive me... I need a moment.
revived: I rise again. Let us continue.
My oath holds. I am with you.
move.caught_up: I found you. Please, do not leave me behind again.
There you are. I feared the worst.
ambient.night: Night falls. Stay close to me.
Darkness comes. I will keep watch.
The undead stir at night. Be ready.
ambient.dawn: Dawn. We have weathered another night.
ambient.rain: Rain. It washes the world clean.
A gentle rain. Good for the farmers.
ambient.thunder: A storm. Seek shelter if you can.
Thunder. Keep your wits about you.
ambient.cave: Keep your torch close. I will watch the shadows.
ambient.idle: Have you eaten, {player}? An empty stomach makes for a poor fighter.
I once stood guard over a village for a hundred nights. Not one villager lost.
I keep a list of every place we have made safe. It grows.
Your armour could use mending. When we have a moment.
ambient.biome.forest: A peaceful wood. Still, keep watch for spiders.
ambient.biome.desert: The desert is harsh. Drink when you can.
ambient.biome.snow: Bitter cold. Keep moving, and keep warm.
ambient.biome.ocean: The sea is beautiful, and merciless.
ambient.biome.jungle: The jungle hides many dangers. Stay close.
ambient.biome.mountain: From up here, one can see every village in need.
ambient.biome.plains: Open fields. Villages often grow here. We should look in on them.
ambient.biome.nether: This place is a wound in the world. Stay close to me.
Mind the ghasts. And mind your step.
ambient.biome.end: A silent, empty place. Whatever lived here is long gone.
callout.chest: A chest. Its owner may still be near. Or long gone.
talk.who: I am {name}. I keep watch, I keep oaths, and I keep my friends alive.
A guardian. Once I protected a village. Now I protect you.
Someone who believes that every life is worth defending.
talk.how: Well enough, while you are safe.
My heart is steady. My sword arm too.
Content, friend. It is good to be useful.
talk.joke: A joke? Very well. Why did the skeleton not fight? It had no guts. ...I am told that is funny.
I once saw an iron golem give a villager a flower. The villager fainted. I laughed for a week.
Why do zombies avoid the sun? They prefer... a darker sense of humour. Forgive me.
talk.thanks: There is no need to thank me.
It is my duty, and my pleasure.
talk.compliment: I only do what anyone should.
talk.insult: I hope that was said in jest.
Even so, I will keep you safe.
talk.likes: Quiet villages. Iron golems. A well-kept shield.
The dawn. It means we survived.
talk.dislikes: Cruelty. And the undead, who know nothing else.
Those who harm the helpless. Pillagers most of all.
talk.where: We are in {biome}. Let us see that it stays peaceful.
{biome}. A fair land, if a dangerous one.
talk.generic: Whatever comes, I am with you.
gift.received: A {item}. Thank you, {player}. I will use it well.
You are generous. Thank you for the {item}.
gift.loved: A {item}! I am deeply grateful, friend.
This {item}... it means a great deal. Thank you.
hurt_by_player: I will assume that was an accident.
fail.owner_gone: I gathered your {item}, but I cannot find you. I will keep them safe.
You are gone from my sight, friend. Your {item} are safe with me.
fail.unsupported: Forgive me, I cannot {action}. I can follow, wait, gather, carry, and defend you.
That is not a skill I possess. To {action} is beyond me.
fail.give_missing: I have no {item} to give. Shall I gather some?
